A '''Lore Keeper''' was a broad term for a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had pursued the school of thought that gave one the title of [[Jedi Consular]] within the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Consisting of [[Jedi archivist/Legends|archivists]], [[Jedi historian|historians]], and [[Jedi librarian/Legends|librarians]], the Lore Keepers maintained the repositories of knowledge that allowed the Order to grow and learn, calling on wisdom from the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] long since past, and contributing knowledge from the scholars of the future.

==Overview==
One of the oldest ranks in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the first Lore Keepers served on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] before the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The stewards of knowledge accumulated by [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Rajivari]], the Lore Keepers tended to the first incarnation of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]]; the [[Fount of Rajivari]].<ref name="TORE" /> As the Order grew and moved to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] and elsewhere the Lore Keeper position became more defined. Divided into three distinct roles within the Order, the Lore Keepers could be found at the Jedi facilities on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Telos IV]], [[Kamparas]], and [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]]. Making up the [[Librarian's Assembly]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] of Coruscant, they oversaw the operation of the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] and answered directly to the [[Council of First Knowledge/Legends|Council of First Knowledge]].<ref name="TJP" /> The leader of the Order's [[Educational Corps]] was the [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]], overseer of the Archives and protector of its knowledge. Provided with personal chambers adjacent to the Archives, the Chief Librarian worked closely with the '''[[Caretaker of First Knowledge/Legends|Caretaker of First Knowledge]]''', the leader of the Council of First Knowledge. On occasion, such as in the time following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]] with Master [[Restelly Quist/Legends|Restelly Quist]], the Chief Librarian also held the title of Caretaker. Quist's predecessor, [[Barra-Rona-Ban]] was the first Chief Librarian following the Reformation and one of the only Jedi to meet [[Darth Zannah/Legends|one]] of the [[Darth Bane/Legends|two]] remaining [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] and survive.<ref name="Darth Bane: Rule of Two">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Even before Master Ban, the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] historian [[Gnost-Dural]] oversaw the recollection of data within the [[Jedi Temple (Tython)/Legends|Temple Archives]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] following the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> The final Chief Librarian, former [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]] died among her beloved books when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] executed [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] on behalf of [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith novelization">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith'']]</ref>

Following the reformation of the Order under [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Tionne Solusar]] took up the mantle of Chief Librarian and restored the Stacks and added information missing from the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RS">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]''</ref> Master Solusar eventually stepped down from this role and the title was given to Master [[Markre Medjev]].<ref name="FOTJA">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Ascension]]''</ref>

===Jedi archivists===
{{Main|Jedi archivist/Legends}}
[[File:Knowledge.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Rachi Sitra]] sought to uncover forgotten knowledge as a historian.]]
The Jedi archivists were tasked with the tedious job of storing all text in the Archives and [[Jedi Archives|library]]. Translating all data in to various common tongues, the archivists would store and sort the information gathered into one of the four halls of the Archives. Specializing in the storage, organization and retrieval of knowledge, they would receive and archive knowledge so that others might learn, and in the process expand their own awareness of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Delving into many areas of study, allowing [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to guide them to their areas of specialty, these Jedi rarely saw combat, and were only sent on data-retrieval missions, or to accompany diplomats in need of a constant stream of information.<ref name="TJP" />

The Jedi archivists were at their height in times of peace, flourishing in their libraries, and growing the Archives to astounding proportions. However, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they became few in number. The older Jedi believed that the younger Jedi at the time did not have the patience to become archivists, instead training to become [[Jedi Guardian/Legends|Jedi Guardians]]. One of the few potential archivists of the era was [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Olee Starstone]]; however, [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] interfered in her training and progress.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

===Jedi librarians===
{{Main|Jedi librarian/Legends}}
[[File:JediScholar.jpg|thumb|150px|An [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] historian with a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]]]]
Walking the halls of the library and Archives, the Jedi librarians were the main interface with the collection of knowledge stored at the Temple and its satellite facilities. Interacting with visiting Jedi and assisted by small [[Droid/Legends|droids]], a librarian could help locate any resource at a moments notice. Some librarians also studied as historians, such as Madame Jocasta Nu in the latter days of the Republic.<ref name="TJP" />

===Jedi historians===
{{Main|Jedi historian}}
{{Quote|We must not repeat the mistakes of the past.|A Jedi historian|<ref name="Threat of the Conqueror">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|cardname=Jedi Historian}}</ref>}}
Jedi historians, or chroniclers, were members of the Librarian's Assembly specializing in research not only into the history of the Jedi, but also the early beginnings of the Republic. The historians were responsible for the oversight and analysis of the [[Holocron/Legends|Holocrons]], led by the Caretaker of First Knowledge, the leader of the Council of First Knowledge.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Historians of the Old Republic sometimes wore special [[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]] with [[Ansata pattern/Legends|Ansata patterns]] on them, signifying an elevated learning to that of their peers. Over the centuries, Madame Nu, her ancient predecessor [[Atris]], and the [[New Jedi Order|reformed Order's]] first historian, [[Tionne Solusar]] were known to dress in these patterns.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force real-life book">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
